# Results 2026-10-22 — v3 re-run @ `f1a872c`

Migrated from `PAIR_RESULTS.md` (v3 re-run section). Reference pools: self +
up to 4 screened cross refs, deflate metas. Same pairs, both input orders
(v2 could only reference track 0 — order mattered). `single` = v2 single-file
payloads, `flq` = v3 bundle.

Random groups (unrelated files): −0.001% (v2) -> up to −6.8%/−3.9% (v3) —
self-similarity inside random WAVs now gets used. No bundle is ever worse
than its standalone files.

## Costs

- Encode ~1.5–2.4× slower (self-analysis FFT per PCM track + screening);
  decode similar or faster. Analysis heap bounded (~150 MiB per analysis,
  decimated); 9-klankbeeld encode peak 9.6 -> 1.9 GiB.
- 255-track cap kept. MP3 mode-2 chain gains ~0.01–0.03% on same-source
  MP3s (kept: per-track choice, never worse).
- Extracting one track (`decode --only`) decodes its ref closure;
  unreferenced tracks are skipped via per-track payload offsets.
